modules.module_title: Conducting pre-operation checks and routine maintenance of the bulldozer

pcs.pc_description: follow the work related instructions given by the supervisor before the shift starts
check oil levels of engine, transmission, differential, hydraulic tank etc. and top up as required
check water level in the radiator and top up as required
check the condition of the parking brake, main horn, reverse horn, warning lamp and headlight

confirm availability and functionality of safety features in the bulldozer like audiovisual alarm, reverse camera, mirrors, horn, seat belt, Roll-Over Protection Structure (ROPS) and Falling Object Protective Structure (FOPS)
check fan belt tension, electrolyte level, and batteries’ terminal tightness
clean the bulldozer and outer element of an air cleaner with compressed air
apply grease to all the required parts
drain accumulated water from the diesel tank
examine track's tension and take action as required
check and take action as per the entries done by the previous operator in the bulldozer logbook
check for any spills/leakages in the engine, hydraulic systems, transmission etc.
plug spill, leakage of oil and lubricants and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
inspect the work site before the commencement of the work

modules.module_title: Recording and reporting the details of bulldozer's pre-operation inspection and maintenance

pcs.pc_description: maintain the operation and maintenance logbook to detail all activities conducted before starting the bulldozer
inform the supervisor of those problems which are not under one's purview

modules.module_title: Starting and driving the bulldozer to the operation area

pcs.pc_description: inspect the site to identify any loose soil, hidden deep trenches or marshy patches where the bulldozer could get stuck before starting the work
follow the load targets, operating speed and time limits specified by the supervisor
inform the supervisor of any problems, while operating the bulldozer
use the correct slings and links
take proper precautions for the safety of other workers and machine while using ripper attachment and blade
follow the walkway rules e.g. operating the bulldozer within the permissible/allocated areas
execute dozing operation safely on down slopes, near banks, bench edges and dump yard

modules.module_title: Engage and maneuver the blade to level the ground

pcs.pc_description: maintain the ground level during accumulation of waste/reject/stack/secondary material
execute dozing operation near the mining working faces/site for proper maneuverability of excavator and dumper
confirm that no other operators travel or stand near the bulldozer during the operation
create space for rain water drainage on the side of the haul road while preparing it
change blade position efficiently as per the requirement
perform dozing operation in conjunction with tilting operation of the blade as per work requirement
prepare the haul road by maintaining the required road quality and dimensions such as width and thickness

pcs.pc_description: track machine operating hours to assess the right service schedule
ensure that the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) recommended procedure and checklist is followed for routine servicing

check complaint sheet, logbook and history sheet of the equipment and identify repair requirements
use diagnostic procedures as defined in the troubleshooting checklist prepared by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)
assess when the problem is beyond one's competence and report the problem to concerned person

modules.module_title: Follow work-site health and safety measures

pcs.pc_description: comply with safety, health, and security- related regulations/guidelines at the opencast mine
follow the safety instructions given by the workman's inspector
follow adequate safety while working at haul roads, heights, overburden dumps, sump area, stockyard, near moving parts, etc.
take safety precautions while working on sites (sub-station, workshop etc.), with equipment, and conducting welding and cutting operations
follow appropriate Safe Operating Procedure (SOP) while dealing with explosives
respond promptly and appropriately to an accident/ incident or an emergency situation, within limits of the role and responsibility
provide first aid to an injured person
operate various types of fire extinguishers to control different types of fire at a worksite when required
use appropriate PPE as per the requirement
maintain hand hygiene by washing hands with alcohol based sanitisers/soap
disinfect the machine/tools before and after work/task
maintain hygiene at the work site
report any symptoms of illness to the shift- incharge
identify the environmental impact of related opencast mining operations
follow the process for collecting, storing and disposing of the hazardous material and waste (like used oil, lubricant, battery, etc.) in compliance with worksite guidelines
ensure not to mix topsoil with waste in day to day tasks
ensure that HEMM is washed at the designated location
ensure the productivity of the machine for material/fuel conservation
follow the mineral conservation practices specified by the organization in accordance with MCDR-2017 (Mineral Conservation and Development Rules)
assist supervisor for reducing environmental impact caused due to related mining operations
